spans.s: मल् vt. 1Ā (pres. मलते) To hold, to possess.
मल्ल् vt. 1Ā (pres. मल्लते) To hold, to possess.

मल (I) m.n. 1. Dirt, filth, dust, any impure matter, छाया न मूर्च्छति मलोपहतप्रसादे शुद्धे तु दर्पणतले सुलभावकाशा Sak.vii.; 2. alloy, rust; 3. sin, moral impurity; 4. an impure excretion of the body; (Manu mentions twelve such excretions- वसा शुक्रमसृङ् मज्जा मूत्रविड् घ्राणकर्णविड् । श्लेष्माश्रुदूषिका स्वेदो द्वादशैते नृणां मलाः); 6. camphor; 6. cuttle-fish-bone; 7. tanned leather.
मल (II) n. A particular base metal.
मल्ल (I) a. (f. ल्ला) 1. Strong, robust; 2. good, excellent.
मल्ल (II) m. 1. A strong man; 2. a professional wrestler; 3. a drinking vessel, a cup; 4. the remnants of an oblation; 5. the cheek and temple.
मल्ल (I) a. (f. ल्ला) 1. Strong, robust; 2. good, excellent.
माल (I) m. 1. Name of a country in the north of India; 2. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 3. name of a tribe of barbarians.
माल (II) n. 1. A field; 2. rising ground, सद्यः सीरोत्कषणसुरभिक्षेत्रमारुह्य मालम् Megh.i.16; 3. fraud, deceit.

माला f. 1. A wreath, a garland, a chaplet, मल्लिकामालभारिण्यः K.D.ii.215; 2. group, a collection; 3. a row, a line, उत्कंठयति मेघानां माला वृंदं कलापिनाम् K.D.ii.118, Megh.i.9, Kir.v.9; 4. a string, a rosary, a necklace; 5. a streak, e.g. तडिन्माला; 6. the offering of several things to obtain wish (in drama).
माल्ल m. Name of a mixed tribe.
मल-अपकर्षण n. 1. removing dirt; 2. removal of sin.
मल-अरि m. a kind of natron.
मल्ल-अरि m. 1. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa; 2. of Śiva.
मल-अवरोध m. constipation of the bowels.
मल-आकर्षिन् m. a sweeper.
मल-आवह a. 1. dirtying, soiling; 2. defiling.
मल-आशय m. the belly.
मल-उत्सर्ग m. voiding of the feces.
मल-ज n. pus, matter.
मल्ल-ज n. black pepper.
मल-द्रव m. diarrhœa.
मल-धात्री f. a nurse who attends to the necessities of a child.
मल-पृष्ठ n. the outer page of a book.
मल-भुज् m. a crow.
मल-मल्लक n. a piece of cloth covering the privities.
मल-मास m. an intercalary month; (so called because no religious ceremonies can be performed in it).
मल-वासस् f. a woman in her courses.
मल-विसर्ग m. evacuation of the feces.
मल-विसर्जन n. evacuation of the feces.
मल-शुद्धि f. evacuation of the feces.
मलन (I) m. A tent.
मलन (II) n. Crushing, grinding.

मलय m. 1. Name of a mountain in the south of India; [this mountain is famous for its sandal trees; the Malaya zephyr charged with the scent of sandal-wood or other herbs is a poetical commonplace, ललितलवंगलतापरिशीलनकोमलमलयसमीरे (सरसवसंते) Git.G.i.], दिनमुखानि रविर्हिमनिग्रहैर्विमलयन् मलयं नगमत्यजत् R.ix.25, iv.51; 2. name of a country lying to the east of the Malaya range; 3. an epithet of the garden of Indra; 4. a garden in general.
मालय (I) a. (f. यी) Coming from the Malaya mountain.
मालय (II) m. Sandal-wood.
मलय-अचल, -अद्रि, -गिरि, -पर्वत, -भूभृत् m. the Malaya mountain.
मलय-अचल, -अद्रि, -गिरि, -पर्वत, -भूभृत् m. the Malaya mountain.
मलय-अचल, -अद्रि, -गिरि, -पर्वत, -भूभृत् m. the Malaya mountain.
मलय-अचल, -अद्रि, -गिरि, -पर्वत, -भूभृत् m. the Malaya mountain.
मलय-अचल, -अद्रि, -गिरि, -पर्वत, -भूभृत् m. the Malaya mountain.
मलय-अनिल, -वात m. wind blowing from the Malaya mountain.
मलय-अनिल, -वात m. wind blowing from the Malaya mountain.
मलय-उद्भव n. sandalwood.
मलय-ज (I) m. a sandal tree, अयि मलयज महिमायं कस्य गिरामस्तु विषयस्ते Bh.V.i.11.
मलय-ज (II) m.n. sandal-wood.
मलय-ज (III) n. an epithet of Rāhu.
मलय-ज˚रजस् n. the dust of sandal, मलयजरजो नेदं भस्म प्रियारहिते मयि Git.G.iii.
मलय-द्रुम m. a sandal tree.
मलय-वासिनी f. an epithet of Durgā.
मलाका f. 1. A libidinous woman; 2. a female messenger; 3. a female elephant.
मल्लक m. 1. A lamp-vessel; 2. a cup made out of a cocoa-nut shell; 3. a lamp; 4. a tooth; 5. a kind of jasmine.
मालक (I) m. 1. The Nimba tree; 2. a vessel made of a cocoanut-shell.
मालक (II) n. A garland.

मलिन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Dirty, impure, unclean, stained, sullied, हस्त इव भूतिमलिनो यथायथा लंघयति खलः सुजनम् Vas.D.; 2. sinful, depraved, bad, मलिनाचरितं कर्म सुरभेर्नन्वसांप्रतम् K.D.ii.178; 3. black, dark, of a dark colour, मलिनमपि हिमांशोर्लक्ष्म लक्ष्मीं तनोति Sak.i., Sis.ix.18; 4. obscured, clouded.
मलिन (II) m. 1. Sin, defect; 2. buttermilk; 3. borax.

मलिन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Dirty, impure, unclean, stained, sullied, हस्त इव भूतिमलिनो यथायथा लंघयति खलः सुजनम् Vas.D.; 2. sinful, depraved, bad, मलिनाचरितं कर्म सुरभेर्नन्वसांप्रतम् K.D.ii.178; 3. black, dark, of a dark colour, मलिनमपि हिमांशोर्लक्ष्म लक्ष्मीं तनोति Sak.i., Sis.ix.18; 4. obscured, clouded.
मलिना f. A woman during menstruation.
मलिन-अंबु n. ink.
मलिन-आस्य a. 1. dirty-faced; 2. vulgar, low; 3. cruel, ferocious.
मलिन-प्रभ a. obscured, sullied.
मलिन-मुख (I) a. 1. dirty-faced; 2. low, vulgar; 3. cruel, savage.
मलिन-मुख (II) m. 1. fire; 2. a kind of monkey; 3. a ghost, an evil spirit.
मलिनय् vt. (denom. pres. मलिनयति) 1. To make dirty, to tarnish, to defile; 2. to corrupt, to spoil.
मलिना f. A woman during menstruation.
मालिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Wearing a garland; 2. encircled by, surrounded by, e.g. अंशुमलिन्, ऊर्मिमालिन् Rt.i.18, R.iv.44.
मालिनी f. 1. A female florist; 2. name of the city of Champā; 3. a girl seven years old personating Durgā at the festival of that goddess; 4. the celestial Ganges; 5. name of a metre. (See App. I.)
मलिनिमन् m. 1. Impurity, sin; 2. darkness, blackness, मलिनिमालिनि माधवयोषिताम् Sis.vi.4; 3. dirtiness, filthiness.
मलिम्लुच m. 1. An intercalary month; 2. air, wind; 3. fire; 4. a thief, a robber; 5. a demon; 6. a musquito; 7. a Brāhmaṇa who neglects the five daily acts of piety.

मलीमस (I) a. (f. सा) 1. Dirty, unclean, stained, R.ii.53; 2. impure, wicked, sinful, मलीमसामदधते न पद्धतिम् R.iii.46; 3. of a dark colour, ऋते रवेः क्षालयितुं क्षमेत कः क्षपातमस्कांडमलीमसं नभः Sis.i.38, पणिता न जनारवैरवैदपि कूजंतमलिं मलीमसम् Na.ii.92.
मलीमस (II) m. 1. iron; 2. green vitriol.

मलीमस (I) a. (f. सा) 1. Dirty, unclean, stained, R.ii.53; 2. impure, wicked, sinful, मलीमसामदधते न पद्धतिम् R.iii.46; 3. of a dark colour, ऋते रवेः क्षालयितुं क्षमेत कः क्षपातमस्कांडमलीमसं नभः Sis.i.38, पणिता न जनारवैरवैदपि कूजंतमलिं मलीमसम् Na.ii.92.
मल्ल-क्रीडा f. a wrestling match.
मल्ल-तूर्य n. a kind of drum.
मल्ल-भू, -भूमि f. 1. a wrestling-ground; 2. name of a country.
मल्ल-भू, -भूमि f. 1. a wrestling-ground; 2. name of a country.
मल्ल-युद्ध n. a pugilistic encounter.
मल्ल-विद्या f. the art of wrestling.
मल्ल-शाला f. a gymnasium.
मल्लि(ल्ली) f. A kind of jasmine.
मल्लि(ल्ली) f. A kind of jasmine.
मल्लि(ल्ली)-गंधि n. a kind of agallochum.
मल्लि(ल्ली)-गंधि n. a kind of agallochum.
मल्लि(ल्ली)-नाथ m. name of a celebrated commentator who probably lived in the beginning of the fifteenth century.
मल्लि(ल्ली)-नाथ m. name of a celebrated commentator who probably lived in the beginning of the fifteenth century.
मल्लि(ल्ली)-पत्र n. a mushroom.
मल्लि(ल्ली)-पत्र n. a mushroom.
मल्लिक m. 1. A kind of goose with brown legs; 2. the month Māgha; 3. a shuttle.

मल्लिका f. 1. A kind of jasmine, वनेषु सायंतनमल्लिकानां विजृंभणोद्गंधिषु कुड्मलेषु R.xvi.47; 2. a flower of this creeper, मल्लिकामालभारिण्यः K.D.ii.215, R.xvi.50; 3. a lamp-stand; 4. an earthen vessel.
मालिक m. 1. A florist, a gardener; 2. a painter.
मालिका f. 1. A garland; 2. a necklace; 3. a row, a series; 4. a kind of jasmine; 5. a daughter; 6. a palace; 7. linseed; 8. a kind of bird.
मल्लिक-अक्ष, -आख्य m. a kind of goose with brown legs and bill, एतस्मिन्मदकलमल्लिकाक्षपक्षव्याधूतस्फुरदुरुदंडपुंडरीकाः (भुवो विभागाः) Ut.i., M.M.ix.
मल्लिक-अक्ष, -आख्य m. a kind of goose with brown legs and bill, एतस्मिन्मदकलमल्लिकाक्षपक्षव्याधूतस्फुरदुरुदंडपुंडरीकाः (भुवो विभागाः) Ut.i., M.M.ix.
मल्लिक-आख्या f. a kind of jasmine.
मल्लिक-अर्जुन m. name of a Linga of Śiva on the Śrīśaila.
मल्लिका-गंध n. a kind of agallochum.
मल्लीकर m. A thief.
मल्लु m. A bear.
मालु f. 1. A woman; 2. a kind of plant.
माल-चक्रक n. the hip-joint.

मालती(ति) f. 1. A kind of jasmine, सममभिनवैर्जालकैर्मालतीनाम Megh.ii.35; 2. the flower of this creeper, ˚मालतिजातिसुगंधौ Git.G.i., Rt.ii.24; 3. a bud, a blossom in general; 4. a young woman; 5. night; 6. moonlight.

मालती(ति) f. 1. A kind of jasmine, सममभिनवैर्जालकैर्मालतीनाम Megh.ii.35; 2. the flower of this creeper, ˚मालतिजातिसुगंधौ Git.G.i., Rt.ii.24; 3. a bud, a blossom in general; 4. a young woman; 5. night; 6. moonlight.
मालती(ति)-क्षारक m. borax.
मालती(ति)-क्षारक m. borax.
मालती(ति)-पत्रिका f. the shell of a nutmeg.
मालती(ति)-पत्रिका f. the shell of a nutmeg.
मालती(ति)-फल n. a nutmeg.
मालती(ति)-फल n. a nutmeg.
मालती(ति)-माला f. a garland of jasmine blossoms.
मालती(ति)-माला f. a garland of jasmine blossoms.
मालय (I) a. (f. यी) Coming from the Malaya mountain.
मालव (I) m. 1. Name of a country now called Mālwā; 2. name of a musical mode.
मालव (II) m. pl. The natives of Mālava.
मालव-अधीश, -इंद्र, -नृपति m. a king of Mālava.
मालव-अधीश, -इंद्र, -नृपति m. a king of Mālava.
मालव-अधीश, -इंद्र, -नृपति m. a king of Mālava.
मालवक m. 1. The country of the Mālavas; 2. a native of that country.
मालसी f. Name of a plant.
माला-उपमा f. an Upamā in which the same upameya is compared to several upamānas, (e.g. अनयेनेव राज्यश्रीर्दैन्येनेव मनस्विना । मम्लौ साथ विषादेन पद्मिनीव हिमांभसा K.Pr.x.).
माला-कर, -कार m. 1. a gardener, a florist, मालाकार व्यरचि भवता या तरोरस्य पुष्टिः Bh.V.i.30, 54; 2. the caste of gardeners.
माला-कर, -कार m. 1. a gardener, a florist, मालाकार व्यरचि भवता या तरोरस्य पुष्टिः Bh.V.i.30, 54; 2. the caste of gardeners.
माला-गुण m. a necklace.
माला-तृण n. a kind of fragrant grass.
माला-दीपक n. a figure of speech, thus defined by Mammata- मालादीपकमाद्यं चेद् यथोत्तरगुणावहम्. Jagaddhara does not recognize this as a separate figure; he thinks it to be a particular kind of एकावली.
मालिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Wearing a garland; 2. encircled by, surrounded by, e.g. अंशुमलिन्, ऊर्मिमालिन् Rt.i.18, R.iv.44.
मालिन् (II) m. A garland-maker, a florist.
मालिन्य n. 1. Foulness, dirtiness, impurity; 2. blackness; 3. sinfulness; 4. trouble, affliction.
मालु-धान m. a kind of snake.
मालूर m. 1. The Bilva tree; 2. the Kapittha tree.
मालेया f. Great cardamoms.
माल्य n. 1. A flower, दिव्यमाल्यांबरधरम् Bg.xi.11; 2. a wreath, a garland, माल्येन तां निर्वचनं जघान K.S.vii.19; 3. a wreath worn on the head.
माल्य-आपण m. a flower-market.
माल्य-जीवक m. a garland-maker.
माल्य-पुष्प m. a kind of hemp.
माल्य-वत् m. 1. name of a mountainous range, R.xiii.26; 2. name of a giant.
माल्य-वृत्ति m. a garland-maker.
माल्लवी f. A wrestling match.
